recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future changes to source/services.html should be handled as separate Services/SOA content work, not as part of FHIR-7951.
issue_request: FHIR-7951 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking to remove the Services #2/SOA page because it had little implementer value; the final resolution says the page no longer exists.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-7951 was found. Git history shows 4152dadee6781c32649dbcd41b7d63ecd5fc4fe3 deleted source/soa.html on 2015-09-18 while revising source/services.html per SOA committee, matching the Jira resolution.
additional_context: FHIR-7952 is a neighboring SOA issue about reshaping the separate Services page into practical guidance, not an instruction to remove every current services artifact. Current source has source/services.html and links to it, but no source/soa.html file, no fhir.ini SOA page entry, and no source references to soa.html. Community searches found no later relevant decision that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current tree already satisfies FHIR-7951 because the obsolete source/soa.html page is gone; removing the retained source/services.html page would exceed the issue scope.

related_jiras.note: Neighboring SOA tracker helps distinguish the deleted SOA page from the retained Services page, but it remains Resolved - change required and was not decided here.
